observations: Q2 revenue was $33.7M, down 12% Y/Y, while software/services/edge-hardware revenue was $33.4M, up 1%, and PowerTrack software revenue rose 11% Y/Y.
GAAP gross margin improved to 41% from 33%; adjusted EBITDA reached $6.2M and operating cash flow was positive $0.3M versus negative $21.3M a year earlier.
Bookings rose 39% sequentially to $36.8M, backlog rose 18% to $27.1M and management reaffirmed 2026 guidance.
factors: software mix and cost discipline are lifting margins
positive adjusted EBITDA and operating cash flow indicate improving operating leverage
bookings/backlog and PowerTrack growth provide forward demand evidence
risks: total revenue still contracted year over year
$38.4M cash balance leaves limited execution cushion relative to larger peers
net loss remains negative despite adjusted EBITDA progress
contradictions: Improving margins, bookings and recurring software metrics coexist with declining total revenue; turnaround quality depends on sustained software growth rather than hardware-mix contraction alone.
unknowns: durability of positive operating cash flow across multiple quarters
backlog conversion timing and recurring-margin contribution
independent market-expectations benchmark for the reaffirmed guidance

recommendation.reason: Current primary evidence remains reusable for growth, margin, cash-flow and backlog underwriting; independent expectations evidence remains an explicit unknown rather than manufactured certainty.
